Settings
All controls
W / SNose down / nose up (arrow keys work too) A / DTurn left / right: the jet banks and turns, and levels out when you let go. Add S for a tighter turn. (Realistic controls: A/D only roll.) Q / ERudder; steers the nose wheel on the deck Shift / CtrlThrottle up / down (also = and −). Stops at 80%; press Shift again for afterburner FOn the deck: hook up to the catapult, then launch G · H · BLanding gear · tailhook · speed brake (wheel brakes on the deck) LandingGear down near the ship and follow the green circle: behind the ship the landing assist takes over (speed, glide slope, lineup; not with Realistic controls). Landing practice: Enter = start the approach over TLock the enemy nearest your nose — jets or ground targets — and get a weapon for it ready (T again = next) SpaceFire / release (guided bombs: when the HUD says IN RANGE — no diving needed) 1 – 5Pick a weapon yourself: 1 heat-seeker · 2 radar missile · 3 small guided bombs / Maverick · 4 bunker buster & bombs · 5 anti-radar CGun (hold) O, then 1 – 5Orders for your wingman Spear 1-2: 1 attack the target you locked or marked with T · 2 cover me · 3 hunt on your own · 4 rejoin on me · 5 go home to the ship XCountermeasures: chaff (fools radar missiles) + flares (fool heat-seekers). Best when the BREAK cue says NOW and the threat is beside you ZChaff only F1 · F2 · F3Cockpit · outside view · weapon camera MSteer your guided missile yourself VNight vision / heat camera L · right-dragLook back · look around KExpert: switch off the G limiter (lets the jet stall) P · EscPause TabHide / show the controls card while flying

Careful: Ctrl+W closes the browser tab. If you're holding W, slow down with − instead of Ctrl.
